<template>
  <v-card  class="mx-auto" color="grey-lighten-3">
    <v-layout>
      <v-app-bar
        color="white"
      >
        <template v-slot:prepend>
          <v-img src="@/assets/logo.png" :width="200" class="custom-v-img"></v-img>
        </template>

        <v-spacer></v-spacer>

        <v-bottom-navigation
          v-model="value"
          mode="shift"
        >
          
        </v-bottom-navigation>
      </v-app-bar>

      <v-main>
        <v-container fluid>
          <v-row dense>
            <v-col
              v-for="n in 4"
              :key="n"
              cols="12"
            >
              <v-card
                :title="`Content ${n}`"
                :subtitle="`Subtitle for Content ${n}`"
                text="Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur, adipisicing elit.?"
              ></v-card>
            </v-col>
          </v-row>
        </v-container>
      </v-main>
    </v-layout>
  </v-card>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: 'DashboardView',
  data() {
    return {
      value: false
    }
  }
}

</script>
